exclusions._comment: Reconciles the netted metrics back to raw. Excluded records are NOT dropped — they stay in conversations[]/new_leads[] carrying the flag that excluded them.

reporting.leads_by_source_note: Counts are across all 234 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (lifetime source attribution), not just today's window.
reporting.leads_by_tag_note: Counts are across all 234 currently-open opportunities in the two project pipelines (not lifetime). A handful of contacts carry more than one lead: tag (e.g. Baljit Grewal has a duplicate opportunity tagged hot in two stages), so tag counts don't sum exactly to 234 minus untagged.
reporting.avg_days_in_stage_note: Cold and Postponed averages are heavily skewed by the 99-contact bulk-import batch frozen since pipeline launch (2025-10-09/29) and two 538-day Postponed records — see workflow_drift stale_approaching/abandonment_next.
reporting.opportunity_status_counts_note: Across all three pipelines combined, lifetime totals (not a daily metric). Matches the documented ~297 won / ~1,132 abandoned scale, drifting slightly as records continue to close.
reporting.store_pipeline_note: STORE: Material Pipeline: 48 open / 6 won / 7 lost / 2 abandoned (63 total, lifetime). Data quirk: of the 48 records returned under status=open, 13 sit in the '6a. Closed - Won' stage and 4 in '6b. Closed - Lost' despite an open status — a stage/status mismatch worth flagging to Albert (see stragglers_ranked), not something this run corrects. No stale thresholds are defined for this pipeline (its own +3d/+8d automated cadence).

stale_thresholds_used._comment: Echoed from platform-settings/ghl-workflow.json so the output is self-describing and a threshold change is visible in the diff.

meeting_window_summary._comment: The window any new Meeting-scheduled follow-up sequence must fit inside. Threshold counts from stage entry, so appointments booked far out shrink the usable runway.

reporting.followup_not_fired_check_note: Scoped this run to today's active conversations and the mobile-quote-tagged contacts appearing in them; no violations found (all had outbound activity within the 5-day window, e.g. Oz Aziz, Clerance Pitters, Baljit Grewal). An updatedAt-based full-account sweep produced false positives (e.g. Baljit Grewal showed 10.9 days since opportunity update despite an outbound SMS today, because opportunity updatedAt only reflects field changes, not conversation activity) — a full sweep needs a proper last-conversation-activity join, not opportunity updatedAt, and was not attempted this run.

drift_findings_breakdown._comment: metrics.drift_findings is the sum of underlying affected records per category, not the count of report lines in workflow_drift (which aggregates large groups into single lines for readability).
